Cloud Application Instance Resource Get Cloud Application Instances
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/cloudApplicationInstances

Retrieves the list of cloud application instances configured in the ZIA Admin Portal. .

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
instanceName
string

The cloud application instance name

instanceType
string

Possible values: [SHAREPOINTONLINE, ONEDRIVE, BOXNET, OKTA, APPSPACE, BITBUCKET, GITHUB, SLACK, QUICK_BASE, ZEPLIN, SOURCEFORGE, ZOOM, WORKDAY, GDRIVE, GOOGLE_WEBMAIL, WINDOWS_LIVE_HOTMAIL, MSTEAM]

The cloud application instance type

page
int32

Specifies the page offset

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size

Default value: 100
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
instanceId
int32

Cloud application instance ID

instanceType
string

Cloud application instance type

Possible values: [SHAREPOINTONLINE, ONEDRIVE, BOXNET, OKTA, APPSPACE, BITBUCKET, GITHUB, SLACK, QUICK_BASE, ZEPLIN, SOURCEFORGE, ZOOM, WORKDAY, GDRIVE, GOOGLE_WEBMAIL, WINDOWS_LIVE_HOTMAIL, MSTEAM]

instanceName
string

Cloud application instance name

modifiedBy
object
modifiedAt
int32

Timestamp of when the instance was last modified

instanceIdentifiers
object[]
]
